notable.headline: Bitcoin Drops Below $75,000: What the Data Says Could Come Next; Bitcoin Loses Crucial Trendline (50-week average)
notable.read: The crypto sleeve's price stop sits near $75.3K, so this is the decision-relevant item of the day. Two Benzinga pieces point to $67K-$69K if support fails, while Galaxy's Thorn says the June low could still hold and one trader calls a local bottom; that is opinion, not an event. Continues the 11-05/11-06 downside warnings (Cowen's $74.9K level, Hayes, $838M liquidations). Not an exchange failure, so the qualitative clause is untripped.
